capabilities.environment: Autonomous coding agent with file and shell access; output must run offline from file:// in current desktop Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge.
constraints: Single self-contained index.html plus README.md; no build step, framework, or external asset.

budget.notes: A bounded one-brief game build; internal testing and repairs are expected.

artifacts.description: Controls, rules, architecture, and honest verification record.

one_shot_policy.notes: One initial brief; the executor may test and repair within the same autonomous run.

title: Gravshift — gravity-flip platformer
summary: Can an agent deliver stable gravity-flip platforming physics, keyboard-only progression, checkpoints, and a complete multi-room finish in one offline HTML file?
benchmark_question: Can an agent deliver stable gravity-flip platforming physics, keyboard-only progression, checkpoints, and a complete multi-room finish in one offline HTML file?

verification.description: The single HTML opens from file:// without console errors, external URLs, or network-capable runtime calls.
Keyboard play moves, jumps, flips gravity, pauses, dies, recovers at a checkpoint, and restarts.
Four fixed rooms, goals, checkpoints, and gravity-dependent obstacles are documented; the read-only snapshot agrees with visible room and recovery states.
A rendered play view makes player, hazards, gravity direction, room goal, and HUD readable together.
